altelium.executive_summary: Altelium is a UK BESS-focused insurtech MGA whose book concentrates on battery storage operating risk rather than broad energy intermediation. Its all-risk BESS programme and telemetry-led monitoring align well with interruptible storage assets, but cover remains largely indemnity-oriented with only partial non-damage trigger design. Preparedness is strong on product fit, data and pricing; exposure reflects a growing UK storage pipeline with moderate grid correlation. MoS +23.8 (earning it) on an assessed-only slice — direction is credible, magnitudes may shift as register-backed BESS placements populate.

All sub-factors are assessed tier — the parametric positioning is evidenced in product design, not yet in measured register fusion.

MoS +32.5 (earning it) reflects strong placement capability against a material intermediated book. Entire profile is assessed; no register-measured sub-factors on this entity yet.

Strong data, pricing and product-fit scores drive MoS +38.7 (whitespace): low direct UK grid book, high parametric preparedness. All ratings are assessed from public product research; UK BESS/DC register linkage is not yet evidenced.

Underwriting expertise (3/4) and reinsurance backing (3/4) are credible for a specialist MGA. Product positioning is directly adjacent to non-firm power risk even where the current book skews US/EU energy rather than UK grid registers.
